title: MBGSP inaugurates new office in Cebu Business Park

blocks.text: Mercedes-Benz Group Services Philippines (MBGSP) marked the inauguration of its new office with a ribbon-cutting ceremony on September 8, 2026, at the AIA Center Cebu Building in Cebu Business Park, Cebu City. “People are at the heart of everything we do. The success of MBGSP is driven by talented professionals who embody our values of pioneering spirit, respect, integrity, and excellence. These values shape how we collaborate, innovate, and continuously improve in delivering high-quality services to the Mercedes-Benz Group,” said Marc Wittkowski, Chief Executive Officer of Mercedes-Benz Group Services Phils., Inc.
